name: Böhönye (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Böhönye (a red and green shield with a horseman, ears of grain and a bunch of grapes) above a yellow scroll inscribed BÖHÖNYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
